insert into order_detail_pay_record ( org_id, patient_id, treatment_record_id, order_record_id,order_detail_id, bill_record_id, receivable_amount, privilege_amount,actual_receivable, received_amount, coupon_workload, crt_id, crt_name, upd_id, upd_name ) values
(#{obj.orgId},#{obj.patientId},#{obj.treatmentRecordId},#{obj.orderRecordId},#{obj.orderDetailId}, #{obj.billRecordId},#{obj.receivableAmount},#{obj.privilegeAmount},#{obj.actualReceivable}, #{obj.receivedAmount},#{obj.couponWorkload},#{obj.crtId},#{obj.crtName},#{obj.updId}, #{obj.updName})
mapper.update: UPDATE order_detail_pay_record odpr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_detail_id, SUM(free_amount) + SUM(received_amount) AS received_amount, SUM(free_amount) AS free_amount FROM bill_pay_share_detail WHERE order_record_id = #{orderRecordId} GROUP BY order_detail_id ) bpsd ON odpr.order_detail_id = bpsd.order_detail_id SET odpr.received_amount = IFNULL(bpsd.received_amount, 0), odpr.free_amount = IFNULL(bpsd.free_amount, 0) WHERE odpr.inservice = true AND odpr.order_record_id = #{orderRecordId}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM( actual_receivable ) ,0) FROM order_detail_pay_record odpr WHERE odpr.bill_record_id = #{billRecordId} AND odpr.privilege_amount = 0
